measurement.estimand: tail-sensitive local-energy dispersion profile over complete draw-by-walker records from a fresh evaluation of a frozen checkpoint
measurement.primary_statistic: W = the 99.9th percentile of A = abs(E_L - median(E_L)), computed on the complete retained draw-by-walker grid
measurement.energy_error_profile: Also report quantiles and exceedance probabilities for abs(E_L + 0.5 Ha) and the signed median energy error.
measurement.complete_record_rule: Every planned draw-by-walker record appears exactly once with finite coordinates and local energy, reconciled source/checkpoint/config/schema identities, and no clipping, filtering, replacement, final-draw shortcut, or pooled partial window.

checkpoint_retention.updates: 0 and every 1000 completed optimizer updates through 50000 inclusive
checkpoint_retention.payload: full available resume payload and committed publication identity; retention does not authorize resume, retry, or reselection
checkpoint_retention.historical_basis: TO:bfb2247e operator-recommendations-accepted-and-horizon-2026-09-04 is evidence for the 1000-update target, not a fresh operator quote

evaluated_checkpoints.distinction: The evaluated set is a subset of the retained set; unevaluated retained checkpoints are not post-result primary selections.

tail_rule.diagnostic: Direct W, quantile, and exceedance profiles are primary. Held-out beta survival-slope curvature and calibrated generalized-Pareto xi are interpretation diagnostics, never replaced by a Hill class declaration.
tail_rule.admissibility: At least 200 held-out exceedances from 50 distinct walkers, finite ordered thresholds, complete identities, and qualified dependence; three adjacent supported intervals at half/full prefixes and common shallower support at quarter prefix.
tail_rule.stability: Proposed relative beta drift <= 0.20 and absolute xi drift <= 0.10 with compatible whole-walker uncertainty intervals.
tail_rule.absence_or_inconclusive: unresolved; an absent admissible tail diagnostic is never a pass

seed_roster.disjointness: Pilot/check seeds are excluded from science; no training, sampler, evaluation, or pilot seed may be reused across namespaces.

decision_rules.recurrence: Complete records and qualified uncertainty exist. For each passing lineage, streams 0/1 select the smallest-mean-W consecutive triple centered at 3000..19000 (earliest tie); streams 2/3 confirm early W (mean at 0 and 1000) exceeds basin W by >=2x and >=0.01 Ha, and at least two of 40000/45000/50000 exceed it by both margins with simultaneous confidence bounds. At least 2 of 3 lineages pass. Tail exceedance safeguards must not contradict the W result.
decision_rules.bounded_null: All 3 lineages are complete and pass instrument/sampling gates; simultaneous inference over every predeclared basin, checkpoint, threshold, and window search excludes the W decrease/rise rule and excludes a late W deterioration of the declared size through 20000. Fixed-threshold exceedance bands also exclude an absolute late increase of 0.002 at every threshold. A flat MAD or nonsignificance alone is not equivalence.
decision_rules.unresolved: Any required record, identity, instrument, dependence/uncertainty qualification, tail safeguard, operator decision, or horizon is absent or inconclusive; a partial lineage result, conflicting streams, unsupported margins, or a tail-only change outside the declared instrument is unresolved.

lane_proposals.proposal: Use the historical He training basin only as context: 5k-block median of within-batch variance on a changing model, about 0.00173 Ha^2; s10=26570 and s90=44982 are definition-dependent onset summaries whose definition is only in the unopened Netscratch report, not basin-departure points. Use W and fixed exceedance probabilities for H.
lane_proposals.rationale: W detects rare-event frequency defects that MAD can hide; no fresh He basin checkpoint exists for a common-estimand threshold.
alternatives: make exceedance probability the primary axis instead of percentile W
use a separately approved recomputed He fresh-evaluation reference

lane_proposals.proposal: 50,000 updates, retain 0..50000 every 1000, evaluate the explicit 27-checkpoint set
lane_proposals.rationale: Dense retention prevents loss of an early basin while the smaller evaluated set controls fresh-evaluation cost.
alternatives: use a 100,000-update horizon or a sparse 15-point evaluation set

lane_proposals.proposal: Three fresh lineages with seeds 73001..73003 and sampler seeds 83001..83003; require two of three for recurrence
lane_proposals.rationale: Three is a bounded first recurrence experiment with independent training identities.
alternatives: one exploratory lineage, which cannot support replicated recurrence
five lineages for more replication at about 67 percent more cost

lane_proposals.proposal: 4096 training walkers; four fresh streams per evaluated checkpoint, 4096 walkers x 256 draws, burn-in 1000 and stride 20; whole-walker resampling with at least 2000 resamples and simultaneous 95 percent bands
lane_proposals.rationale: Separate stream replication, complete histories, and conservative zero-event bounds protect against dependence and rare-event overclaiming.
alternatives: two streams, accepting weaker basin-selection/confirmation power

lane_proposals.proposal: Use direct W plus exceedance safeguards; beta/xi are held-out context diagnostics. Use factor-2 and 0.01 Ha W margins and 0.002 absolute exceedance-probability safeguard.
lane_proposals.rationale: The decision remains distributional without claiming an ultimate tail class or population variance.
alternatives: require all three seeds or use a tenfold effect threshold

lane_proposals.proposal: FASRC Cannon, one full A100 per lineage, at most 32 GPU-hours per lineage and 96 total; pilot must project the complete unchanged plan. Polaris packed-node science is not assumed.
lane_proposals.rationale: A single-card Cannon stratum is simpler before multi-GPU placement is qualified.
alternatives: efficiently packed Polaris node after placement and utilization qualification
a revised lower-cost plan with lost timing or replication power stated
